messages:
Elena: Morning team — quick huddle note before the leadership calls. High level: we're holding GA timeline for Private in EU but tightening the SLA targets for Dedicated. More below.
Ravi: Good morning. Quick metric highlights: p50 inference latency down 12% this week; p95 improved 7% after the kernel swap on x86 clusters. Cost/unit on the hosted API decreased 6% q/q due to smarter batching.
Jordan: Product asks: we need a clear rollback criteria for the new routing policy rollout. Also want to lock on the default quantization profile for small-model routes.
Kai: Incident summary — Thursday afternoon we had a 30m packet-loss blip in eu-west-1 that caused ~6% of requests to fallback to high-cost tier. Root cause: noisy neighbor on node pool; mitigations applied and move-to-drain policy adjusted.
Maya: Customer impact: three larger customers saw retries; CS opened proactive tickets and offered credits. No escalations beyond standard SLA credits.
Elena: Decisions: 1) Do not widen GA window. Keep private GA end of quarter but add one week of canary in APAC. 2) Set Dedicated SLA p95 target to 420ms for small models; teams to propose infra changes by EOD Tue.
Ravi: Actions in infra: - schedule config push to adjust autoscaler thresholds - apply prefix-KV cache warmup for long-tail routes - test reroute fallbacks under simulated capacity.
Kai: I'll lead infra action. Runbook changes: updating the fallback thresholds and adding an alert for cross-AZ packet-loss >0.5% within 5m. ops-bot will post test results.
ops-bot: Deploy started: `deploy infra/fallback-thresholds v1.3` — CI passed, canary to 10% traffic in eu-west-1 at 09:30 UTC.
Jordan: Product follow-ups: add a short FAQ for customers about GA expectations and the new SLA wording. Also set up a weekly 15m sync with Solutions Eng for the first 4 weeks post-GA.
Elena: Risks to watch: cost creep if fallback rates spike; model regressions with quantization; cross-region networking anomalies. Next touchpoint Friday 10:00 UTC. Thanks — small asks only this week, focus on making GA predictable.
Ravi: Noted. I'll post infra timelines and owners in #eng-infra by EOD.
Maya: CS will send the customer-facing note draft by tomorrow noon.
Elena: Solid. :thumbsup: End of thread.
